{{Top|leg}}
'''Slott''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Slott commented on the entry for [[TerexComm]]'s [[DataSearch Engine 9C]], offering tips for reducing the chances of destroying encrypted files.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
